subject.title: test(ui): fix Node 25+ localStorage crashes in jsdom suites; document PR-open CI drops

question: Should root PR-creation guidance prescribe close/reopen recovery after checking both the PR head and GitHub test-merge commit, rather than treating head-SHA-only checks as authoritative?
rationale: This is a repository-wide operational policy that can trigger GitHub lifecycle mutations; the correct permanent verification rule needs maintainer confirmation even though the immediate wording defect is clear.

options.title: Correct the check identity
options.body: Accept a matching workflow on either the head SHA or current test-merge SHA, and reopen only when neither has an attached CI run.

options.title: Remove the recovery rule
options.body: Keep the Node test fix but omit close/reopen guidance until the CI-drop condition has a repository-owned diagnostic and recovery path.

recommendation.title: Correct the check identity
recommendation.body: Accept a matching workflow on either the head SHA or current test-merge SHA, and reopen only when neither has an attached CI run.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent merged contributor closest to this UI test and PR-creation workflow change.
